text: Mayor and Councillors Vrbanovic, Davey, Jr.: Good afternoon everyone and welcome to the special
Council meeting on June 2, 2025. Individuals interested in participating in today's meeting
were eligible to register online using the delegation registration form at www.kitchener.ca
slash delegation or via email at delegation at kitchener dot ca any written comments received
prior to the commencement of today's meeting have been shared with members of council and
will form part of the public record the meeting live stream and archive videos are available at
www.kitchener.ca slash watch now before we begin this afternoon's meeting i'd like to acknowledge
that today we're gathering on the traditional territory of the neutral anishinabeg and
Haudenosaunee peoples. We recognize our responsibility to serve as stewards of the land and honor
the original caretakers who came before us. Our community is enriched by the enduring
knowledge and deep-rooted traditions of the diverse First Nations, Métis, Inuit and Kitchener
today. Are there any disclosures of pecuniary interest?
There being none, I would like to make note of the all-council meeting that will be taking
place on Friday, June 13th beginning at 2.30. Further notice of the meeting will be published
at www.regionofwaterloo.ca and that will be a meeting of all seven area municipal councils
as well as the region. And I believe the location is still being finalized so we'll get back
to you on that. There are no delegations, no mayoral business. Motion to go in camera
for the noted items. Moved by Councillor Michaud, seconded by Councillor Ioannidis.
All those in favour? Opposed? That's carried. Motion to recess. Councillor Schnider, Councillor
Chapman. All those in favour, opposed. That's carried.
Thank you.
Thank you.
Good evening, everyone, and welcome back
to the special counsel meeting for Monday, June 2, 2025. There are two items that are
coming out of caucus for consideration here in special counsel. I ask the clerk to please
post the first item. It has to do with contract negotiations involving our 2025-2029 collective
agreement with IBW 636 with the motion that it be approved and everything executed. Is

Deneau, seconded by Councillor Stretch. Any discussion? All those in favour? Any opposed?
That is carried.
